text:
elaine (Partnerships): Heads-up — SaturnCloud wants us to onboard a new nodepool in ms-sabah-1 for their marketplace listing. They need 12 A10G-equivalent GPUs (reserved) + marketplace entitlement before launch next Monday.

sanjay (SaturnCloud): Confirmed. Targeting a soft-launch 2026-04-06. We can tolerate limited burst but need guaranteed baseline for 5 qps inference per tenant.

mike (Cloud Ops): What SKU IDs do they need? We need exact quota lines for cloud marketplace entitlement and the reserved capacity ticket.

sanjay (SaturnCloud): SKU list from our side: ["GPU_A10G_v1", "A10G_PREEMPT"] but will prefer non-preempt for SLA. Also KMS key access for their marketplace images.

elaine (Partnerships): @mike tagging infra requirements: reserved non-preempt = 12, burst capacity 6, quota window 90 days rolling. Also need the marketplace entitlement mapping so partner tile shows "dedicated capacity" option.

kai (Solutions): Two ops notes: 1) model sizes will likely use 40–60GB memory throe per shard, recommend 2 shards per GPU until infra confirms perf. 2) Suggest canary with 2 tenants before full listing.

mike (Cloud Ops): I'll open a capacity ticket with cloud provider and internal pool owners. ETA for response ~24h. Need exact marketplace entitlement JSON from legal/partner team to attach.

rachael (Legal): We need to review the entitlement text (data residency wording) and the joint-announce press paragraph. Can @sanjay drop the partner-facing T&C snippet you intend to show in the marketplace tile?

sanjay (SaturnCloud): Tile copy draft: "SaturnCloud: managed MLOps with guaranteed inference capacity in ms-sabah-1. Reserved GPU options, private VPC, KMS-backed images." Happy to share T&C draft in DM.

elaine (Partnerships): Good start. Make sure we don't promise SLA language beyond Redwood Dedicated terms. Add: "subject to capacity reservations and region availability."

sanjay (SaturnCloud): Ack, will adjust.

mike (Cloud Ops): For the entitlement object we require the following minimal fields: region, sku_ids, reserved_count, burst_allowed(true/false), kms_required. Example to paste into ticket:
```
{
  "region": "ms-sabah-1",
  "sku_ids": ["GPU_A10G_v1"],
  "reserved_count": 12,
  "burst_allowed": true,
  "kms_required": true
}
```

kai (Solutions): Also need an ops playbook snippet for fallback: what to route to if reserved exhausted — fallback to hosted tier in neighboring region or lower-capacity SKU? Recommend auto-fallback to eu-west-1 hosted for latency-sensitive customers.

elaine (Partnerships): Let's decide fallback policy before listing. @mike can you propose an automated fallback rule in the rollout? e.g., 3 consecutive allocation failures => route to eu-west-1 hosted and notify partner.

mike (Cloud Ops): Yes. I'll include a route policy: "/policy/fallback/ms-sabah-1 => eu-west-1-hosted" with alerting and opt-out flag for partner. Will include in ticket.

deploy-bot: build #deploy-ops 1723 started by mike at 1759999120 — creating capacity-request-1759999001.

rachael (Legal): Quick note on KMS: partner key must be added to our allowlist and a cross-account policy provided. Need key ARN and attestation from partner infra team.

sanjay (SaturnCloud): We'll provide key ARN + attestation by EOD. Also PR for marketplace listing assets (tile images + docs) is ready: https://git.redwood/saturncloud/marketplace-pr

elaine (Partnerships): Action items recap:
- @sanjay: provide final SKU list, KMS ARN, and adjusted tile copy (EOD).
- @mike: open capacity + entitlement ticket with cloud provider, include fallback policy (today).
- @rachael: draft short marketplace entitlement language and confirm allowable T&C (tomorrow morning).
- @kai: create canary runbook (2 tenants, metrics to watch: p95 latency, error rate, token throughput).

sanjay (SaturnCloud): Will do. Appreciate the quick turn.

mike (Cloud Ops): Ticket created: CP-4521 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CP-4521) — provider confirm ETA 18h. I attached entitlement JSON from above.

elaine (Partnerships): Perfect. Once provider confirms, we'll schedule a joint canary next Thurs. I'll coordinate comms with marketing for a joint announcement if canary is green.

sanjay (SaturnCloud): Can we get a checklist for marketplace QA? images, attestations, test creds?

kai (Solutions): I'll DM the checklist and add it to the PR as a template.

deploy-bot: capacity-request-1759999001 -> CP-4521 updated with provider response: pending quota validation (1759999370).

mike (Cloud Ops): Provider returned preliminary approval for 8/12 non-preempt GPUs; final approval pending internal pooling decision. Might need shortfall plan.

elaine (Partnerships): Okay note: if only 8 approved, proceed with canary limited to 1 tenant per shard and postpone full listing until additional capacity procured. We'll need to update partner and marketing.

sanjay (SaturnCloud): Understood. Update us when you have final numbers.

rachael (Legal): I'll prepare a fallback-friendly marketplace wording to avoid overcommitment. Will post draft here.

elaine (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: tag this thread with CP-4521 and PR link. I'll ping Monday morning for status.

mike (Cloud Ops): tagging done. Last update expected by 1759999472.

elaine (Partnerships): Closing thread for now — will reopen when CP-4521 moves to approved. :handshake:
